# Vendored browser libraries

Served from this server (the page's Content-Security-Policy allows scripts from `'self'` only), pinned, no build step.

| File | What | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | D3: map projection (`d3-geo`), zoom and pan (`d3-zoom`), selections | 7.9.0 | ISC (`d3-LICENSE.txt`) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js` |

`d3.min.js` sha256: `f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539`.
